QuestInfo.name: Ratz Elimination
QuestInfo.0: Gold Richie is looking for someone to help him. Go see Gold Richie.
QuestInfo.1: Gold Richie had been storing goods to support the Resistance, but the Ratz in his Storage Room have been eating the goods. Take out the Mouse Traps from the boxes in the Storage Room, install the #bMouse Traps#k, and eliminate the #bRatz#k.\n\n#i4032813##t4032813# #b#c4032813##k/10
QuestInfo.2: You caught all the Ratz inside Gold Richie's Storage Room.

0.0: I need someone to do a job for me... What do you think? Interested?

yes.0: I've put a pile of things for the Resistance in my Storage Room. But, recently, there's been a #bRatz#k infestation, and they've been gnawing through my things. There won't be anything left in that Storage Room, unless I do something quick.
yes.1: So, I need your help. If you go to the Storage Room, you will find some Mouse Traps inside the box. With those Mouse Traps,  #bcatch#k #b10#k Ratz for me. Ratz are really fast, so it won't be easy... But, I know you can do it!

no.0: Come see me later if you change your mind.

1.0: How's my Storage Room? And my things? Are they all there?

yes.0: You've caught all 10 Ratz! Good work! My treasures in the Storage Room are safe now.

item.0: Look, I told you to catch #b10#k #bRatz#k.
